summary: Borr Drilling filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 15, 2026, providing operational and contracting updates rather than a special-situation event. The Odin commenced its contract offshore Texas and began earning dayrates on September 11, 2026, following mid-August mobilization and acceptance testing. The Idun secured a three-well Vietnam campaign of roughly 130 days starting in Q4 2026, continuing its current contract. Eni exercised a nine-month option on the Bestla, extending to September 2027, with a further nine-month fixed-price option remaining. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics were disclosed; routine fleet and backlog news.
